info.name: API Contract Testing · Local Catalog
info.description: Explore the fictional catalog API and its WireMock scenarios. Start the provider on port 8081 and WireMock on port 8080. Each folder uses its own collection URL variable, so no environment is required. Run only the folder for the server you started, or start both and run the full collection. No credentials or request body are required. See docs/api.md in the repository for setup and expected responses. Saved examples are included for offline inspection.
